mitmConsent.body: When enabled, HTTPS traffic from AI tools launched by CiCy (claude / codex, etc.) to AI providers (Claude / OpenAI / DeepSeek / Gemini) is decrypted locally for auditing. Data stays local; turn it off anytime.
mitmConsent.adminNote: Applies only to AI tools launched by CiCy (via an environment variable) — your system is not modified and no administrator access is needed.
mitmConsent.scopeNote: Only traffic to the AI provider domains above is decrypted; all other traffic (banking, social, other sites) is never decrypted or read.
mitmConsent.localNote: Decrypted data is stored only on your machine and is never uploaded to any server.
mitmConsent.grantedDesc: HTTPS auditing is on for AI tools launched by CiCy (claude / codex, etc.); you can turn it off anytime.
mitmConsent.revokeConfirm: Revoking will stop decryption auditing and clear the consent flag. Continue?
mitmConsent.errorAdminDenied: Administrator authorization was not granted; cancelled.

firstRunTerms.title: Terms of Use & Authorization Notice
firstRunTerms.subtitle: Please read and accept the following before using CiCy Desktop
firstRunTerms.summary1: CiCy Desktop is an AI agent orchestration tool that runs on your own computer, helping you coordinate third-party AI assistants (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, etc.) to get work done.
firstRunTerms.summary2: Third-party AI and accounts are between you and the respective provider: which AI you use, whose account you log in with, and the usage and fees are your decision and responsibility, not CiCy's.
firstRunTerms.summary3: To do the work, this software needs a range of authorizations on your computer (running programs, executing scripts, controlling the browser, accessing files, etc.). You are fully responsible for the operations initiated through this software.
firstRunTerms.summary4: Your data stays on your machine by default; CiCy does not upload your work content for operational purposes.
firstRunTerms.summary5: Two high-risk capabilities require your separate, explicit authorization and are off by default: (a) local HTTPS traffic auditing (installs a certificate, requires administrator); (b) local command/script execution. Accepting these Terms does not enable them.
firstRunTerms.summary6: You must not use this software to control unauthorized devices, conduct unlawful multi-accounting / traffic faking, circumvent platform risk controls, or scrape in violation of terms.
firstRunTerms.mustAgree: You cannot use this software without accepting the Terms.
firstRunTerms.scrollHint: Please read to the end to continue
